text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……ただ王ではなく友として、
ノクティスは想いを遺したのです。
text.official_en: He simply wanted to speak to the others one last time—not as their monarch, but as their friend.
text.real_en: But Noctis shared what was in his heart, not as their king, but as their friend.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとノクティスは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Noctis are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとノクティスは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Noctis are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれど彼は、悩みながら失ったものが多すぎて
その歩みを止めることができなかったのです。
text.official_en: However, his journey had already cost him a great deal; were he to have turned back then, all that effort would have been for naught.
text.real_en: But as he struggled with the decision, Noctis had lost too much along the way to bring himself to stop.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
それが王の運命でも、重すぎる責任を
受け入れられずに悩むのは当然です。
text.official_en: While ascending the throne has its advantages, it also comes with burdens in equal—if not greater—measure.
text.real_en: Even if it is a king’s destiny, it is only natural to struggle with a responsibility too heavy to accept.

text.jp: それが運命なら従う
text.official_en: Follow your destiny and complete the journey.
text.real_en: Accept it if that is your destiny.

text.jp:
それでもノクティスは、言えずにいた
胸の内を、しっかりと友へ伝えました。
text.official_en: In spite of that, however, Noctis chose to finally say his piece, rather than leave his thoughts unspoken.
text.real_en: Even so, Noctis made sure to tell his friends what he had kept to himself.

text.jp: それでも一緒に旅したい
text.official_en: Entreat them to continue on with you.
text.real_en: Still want to travel together.

text.jp: それは、永き夜に沈みゆく異界の記憶――
text.official_en: A world that is plagued by daemonic creatures and plunged into eternal night.
text.real_en: A memory of another world sinking into an endless night...

text.jp:
でも信じる仲間なら理解してくれるでしょう。
ノクティスも、そんな友に恵まれたのです。
text.official_en: Should you be blessed, however, with companions who know you well—as was Noctis—you may not even need to say a word.
text.real_en: But companions you trust will surely understand. Noctis was blessed with friends like that.

text.jp:
どれほど考えても答えが見つからないなら
「答えられない」という答えもあります。
text.official_en: There will be times when, no matter how much you pontificate, you will not find an answer...and there is no shame in that.
text.real_en: If you cannot find an answer no matter how hard you think, “I cannot answer” is an answer too.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ノクティスにも、かけがえのない友がいて
ともに迷いながらも、支え合いました。
text.official_en: Noctis had much that troubled him on his journey, yet he was able to overcome all that and more due to the presence of his friends.
text.real_en: Noctis too had irreplaceable friends. Even as they struggled with doubts, they supported one another.

text.jp:
ノクティスの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Noctis’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ノクティスの言葉とは異なりますが、
あなたが託した想いは遺されるでしょう。
text.official_en: Though Noctis’ final words may indeed have been different, yours would resonate no less with your comrades.
text.real_en: Though Noctis's words were different, the feelings you leave behind will endure.

text.jp:
ノクティスは、そこまで割り切れず
重すぎる王の責任に思い悩みました。
text.official_en: Noctis, however, was much less confident; he harbored doubts as to whether or not he was fit to wear the crown.
text.real_en: Noctis could not accept his fate so readily, and agonized over the heavy responsibilities of kingship.

text.jp:
ノクティスは痛みを抱えても旅をつづけ
王としての力を受け取ります。
text.official_en: After enduring innumerous trials and tribulations, Noctis could at last employ the full extent of his powers.
text.real_en: Noctis continued his journey despite the pain and received the power of a king.

text.jp:
ノクティスもあなたと同じように
どうしようもない苦悩を抱えます。
text.official_en: The specter of those regal burdens haunted Noctis as well over the course of his journey.
text.real_en: Noctis struggled with the same overwhelming anguish.

text.jp:
世界から闇を祓い、光を取り戻せるのは彼だけ。
真の王として、自らの未来を捧げると決意します。
text.official_en: Yet, as the True King, he must give himself up to his newfound powers and leave his companions behind.
text.real_en: Only he could drive away the darkness and restore light to the world. As the True King, he resolved to sacrifice his own future.

text.jp: 仲間がいれば大丈夫
text.official_en: Take comfort in the fact your friends are with you.

text.jp:
仲間が傷つくとしても、離れたくない……
素直な気持ちほど、口には出しにくいものです。
text.official_en: You wish for your friendship to remain strong in the face of adversity...yet summoning the courage to say so can be a formidable task.
text.real_en: Even if your friends might be hurt, you do not want to part from them... The most honest feelings can be the hardest to say aloud.

text.jp:
困難な道のりでも、ともに歩んでくれる
仲間がいるのは、素晴らしいですね。
text.official_en: Though the road ahead may be long and winding, were loyal companions to accompany you, it would feel like a short jaunt.
text.real_en: It is a wonderful thing to have friends who will walk beside you, however difficult the road.

text.jp:
変えられない運命を受け入れる覚悟は
揺らがず、止めてほしいわけでもない。
text.official_en: Though Noctis, too, wished to make this point, it was not due to a wavering resolve or a desire to be stopped.
text.real_en: His resolve to accept an unchangeable fate never wavered, and he did not wish to be stopped.

text.jp:
平和の光は戦火に消えて
闇の侵略が迫る世界――
text.official_en: The light of peace faded as war took hold, and darkness cast its veil over the land.
text.real_en: The light of peace vanished in the flames of war, and an invasion of darkness loomed over the world...

text.jp:
彼の名は、ノクティス……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That prince’s name was Noctis, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Noctis... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp: 悩んで答えを出せない
text.official_en: Ruminate on it to no avail.
text.real_en: Struggle, unable to find an answer.

text.jp:
残酷な運命を背負って悩むノクティスへ
友がそれぞれに手を差し伸べました。
text.official_en: When Noctis was beset by woe over his cruel fate, his friends were there to help him find the answer he needed.
text.real_en: His friends each reached out to Noctis as he struggled under his cruel fate.

text.jp:
王としての重い責任を背負って
旅立つことになったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to embark on a journey—not merely as a member of the royal family, but as the future monarch—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you had to set out on a journey carrying the heavy responsibilities of a king, what would you do?

text.jp:
王の使命を果たすと覚悟したノクティスのように
友との別れに、言葉を遺すなら――
あなたなら、何を語りますか？
text.official_en: Were you thrust into a similar situation—where, to fulfill your destiny as king, you must part ways with your companions—what would you impress upon them?
text.real_en: If, like Noctis, you had resolved to fulfill your duty as king and wanted to leave words for your friends before parting, what would you say?

text.jp:
王の宿命を背負いし異界の幻影　ノクティス
多彩なる武具を召喚し、闇に抗う。
text.official_en:
Royal Burden Bearer Noctis
The prince who wielded myriad weapons and battled stygian blights.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision bearing the fate of a king: Noctis. Summoning many kinds of weapons, he stands against the darkness.

text.jp:
王の旅は、苦難に満ちたものでした。
旅をつづければ、仲間が傷つくとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: The steps to the throne are lined with hardships; inevitably, some of those in your retinue will be wounded. Were that to happen, what would you do?
text.real_en: The king’s journey was filled with hardship. If continuing would put your friends in danger, what would you do?

text.jp:
王の為すべきことを、やりとげる覚悟……。
苦悩を越えた決意を語るのですね。
text.official_en: You would speak of determination and of duty...and from experience, which would, in turn, speak volumes.
text.real_en: You would speak of your determination to carry out a king’s duty... A resolve born from overcoming suffering.

text.jp:
生まれながらに「王としての運命」を背負い
悩み生きていく若者がいました。
text.official_en: Amidst this atramentous crisis, a prince struggled to accept his fate as his nation’s future king.
text.real_en: A young man was born bearing the fate of a king, and lived with the weight of that destiny.

text.jp:
答えもわからず歩むしかない、王としての道。
不安を紛らわせてくれたのは、友でした。
text.official_en: He was met with his own reservations at every turn, yet Noctis still walked the path of monarch, due in large part to his comrades.
text.real_en: He had to walk the path of a king without knowing the answers. It was his friends who eased his fears.

text.jp: 語らなくても伝わるはず
text.official_en: Nothing, for there is no need.
text.real_en: They will understand without words.

text.jp: 責任が重すぎてとまどう
text.official_en: Feel overwhelmed by the responsibility.

text.jp: 迷うことなく旅をやめる
text.official_en: Immediately end the journey.

text.jp:
迷わない強さと、優しさを感じます。
ノクティスも同じ選択をしたかもしれません。
text.official_en: An answer that demonstrates both your determination and your kindness. Under different circumstances, Noctis may have answered the same.
text.real_en: I sense both strength and kindness in your unwavering choice. Noctis might have made the same choice.

text.jp: 運命をまっとうする辛さ
text.official_en: How heavy a burden fate can be.
text.real_en: How painful it is to bear your fate.

text.jp: 運命を背負う意気込み
text.official_en: The importance of your mission.
text.real_en: Your determination to bear your fate.

text.jp:
重い責任であろうと、自分の運命なら背負う。
あなたの選択には強い意志を感じます。
text.official_en: The strength of your will is something to be admired; you would carry any burden, no matter how heavy, were it your charge to do so.

text.jp:
野営を張り、炎を囲み語り合う、そんな
ひとときを、永遠のように感じていても……。
text.official_en: Together they set up camp, gathered around the fire, and chewed the fat—moments of reprieve that, alas, were fleeting.
text.real_en: They camped, talked around the fire... Those moments could feel as though they might last forever, but...

text.jp:
長い時をともにした仲間なら、語らなくとも
伝わると、信じることもできるでしょう。
text.official_en: You have spent countless hours together and share a deep connection; whatever you might say, they can likely already infer.
text.real_en: After so long together, you could trust your friends to understand without being told.
